description: An abstract Java class for measuring and handling authentication timing and errors within a security gateway, including error handling, logging, and exception conversion.

classes.name: TimeMeasuringAuthenticationProvider
classes.description: An abstract class that measures authentication duration, handles success and failure, logs, and converts exceptions during authentication requests.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs authentication, measures time, tags success/failure, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: getRootCause
methods.description: Extracts the root cause from a Throwable, unwrapping CompletionException if present.

methods.name: isInternalError
methods.description: Checks if an HttpStatusCode indicates an internal server error.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the authorization context type for a request.

methods.name: tryToAuthenticate
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the actual authentication logic.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Abstract method to create a failed authentication result based on an exception.

methods.name: toDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts a Throwable into a DittoRuntimeException, unwrapping or building internal error exceptions.

methods.name: unwrapDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Recursively unwraps a Throwable to find a DittoRuntimeException, attaching headers if needed.

methods.name: failOnTimeout
methods.description: Wraps an authentication future to handle timeout failures.

methods.name: buildInternalErrorException
methods.description: Builds a GatewayAuthenticationProviderUnavailableException with cause and headers.
